records.title: 10-K
records.text: IET revenue increased $2.1 billion, primarily driven by Gas Technology Equipment revenue.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: We capitalized on market tailwinds to deliver substantial IET revenue growth, navigated an uneven market to deliver modest OFSE revenue growth, and realized widening benefits from our transformation efforts across the company.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: In 2024, the Company generated revenues of $27.8 billion, compared to $25.5 billion in 2023, increasing $2.3 billion or 9%.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: The increase to operating income was driven by higher volume primarily from higher proportionate growth in Gas Technology Equipment ("GTE") and Subsea & Surface Pressure Systems ("SSPS") and price in both segments, and structural cost-out initiatives across the company, partially offset by cost inflation.

records.title: 10-K
records.text: Operating income was $3.1 billion compared to $2.3 billion in 2023, increasing $0.8 billion.
